prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Trip plan". I'll tell you where I'm going, when, and what I like. Write a day-by-day plan under "Days" with append_to_note: a "###" heading per day with three to five bullets, and keep it realistic, with travel time between places. When I paste a booking confirmation, add a row to the Bookings table with log_table_row (What, When, Confirmation, Paid). Add anything this trip needs to the "Packing" checklist, and save places I mention for later under "Ideas".

asks: Lisbon, 4 days in May. I like food, views and walking. Not museums.
What do I still need to book?

args.text:
### Thursday 14 May
- Land 10:40, drop bags at the hotel
- Lunch at Time Out Market
- Sunset at Miradouro da Senhora do Monte

### Friday 15 May
- Tram 28 before 9, ahead of the crowds
- Alfama on foot, lunch at a tasca
- Dinner at Ramiro (book ahead)

- [ ] Sunglasses
- [ ] A light jacket for the evenings

- Day trip to Sintra
- LX Factory on Sunday
